Brand Guidelines

Gold light on dark water.

A premium stay and private electric-scooter experience above Brněnská přehrada — Rozdrojovice, Jižní Morava. This document collects the visual system: logo, palette, type, motifs, and voice.

01  The Logo

A citadel, reflected in still water

A geometric art-deco keep with stepped towers and a crenellated crown, set over three fading ripple-lines. Built as outline paths — resolution-independent and font-free.

Horizontal lockup
Stacked lockup
Icon — app / avatar
Glyph — bare mark
02  Colour

Matte black, rich gold, a breath of cream

Black is the ground, always. Gold is reserved for what matters — it should feel like foil catching light, never a flat fill. Cream carries the reading text.

05  Voice

How Citadela speaks

Like a five-star concierge who already knows your name — confident, unhurried, never loud. Evocative over descriptive. Short sentences. Let the silence do some of the work.

I

Exclusivity

An address that answers only to you. Small on purpose — a limited collection of suites and a single concierge.

II

Nature

Moravia, distilled to water and light. You don't visit the landscape here; you wake inside it.

III

Freedom

The shoreline, on your own current. A private electric scooter, charged and waiting. No timetable, no trace.

06  The Poster

Gilded stillness

The brand at full voice — an art-deco travel plate, gold line on black, the fortress crowning its hill above a shimmering reservoir.
